implementation_strategy: Run hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter pilot: execute paired baseline vs guarded per synthetic intent tasks 1–50; for each task call hosted model once per condition (2 calls/task) under the adapter's constrained decoding and verifier wrapper; deterministic automated scorer compares emulation outcomes to produce paired binary indicators.
public_resources: Dockerized CPU testbed with Mininet + verifier scripts (public repo)
task_manifest_strategy: Use deterministic seed pool and template engine to generate 50 synthetic intents (balanced across four vendor-clusters where possible); task indices 1..50 map to these seeds and are published with hashes.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline uses direct_configuration_generation_v1; guarded uses generate_validate_repair_v1 implemented within adapter; all sanitization and grammar constraints applied deterministically by adapter code.
randomisation_plan: Intent seed selection deterministic pseudorandom draw from preregistered seed pool; published seed list ensures reproducibility.
caching_plan: No local GPU caches; API responses and verifier outputs cached in artifact store with content-addressed hashes for replay and verification.
failure_recovery_plan: On API transient error retry per adapter policy (single attempt allowed per maximum_attempts_per_call); technical failures logged and excluded per preregistered missingness_plan.
result_schema: Per-intent paired binary unsafe indicator (paired between guarded and baseline) with auxiliary fields: model_call_count, verifier_decision, emulation_outcome, failure_category, artifact_hash.
estimated_compute_notes: Total model calls = task_count * 2 = 50*2 = 100 calls (exact, per adapter contract). All runs use hosted API; Dockerized CPU testbed runs verifier and Mininet emulation. Estimated wall-clock ≤7 days.
